headline: BKF Acquires Waterways Consulting to Expand Ecological Engineering Capabilities
summary: BKF has acquired Waterways Consulting, Inc., a firm specializing in water resource engineering, ecological restoration, and nature-based design. The acquisition aims to scale BKF's water resilience capabilities.
why: Engineering firms often acquire specialized consultants to broaden their service offerings and capture market share in infrastructure and environmental sustainability projects.

impacts.name: BKF
impacts.why: Acquisitions can lead to long-term growth but involve integration risks and capital expenditure.
